input.summary: Replace unilateral 7-year Licensor-option renewal with 12-month renewals by mutual written agreement and a CPI/3% cap on renewal fees.
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the seven-year renewal exercisable at Licensor's sole option with successive twelve-month renewals by mutual written agreement (consistent with Article IV.II and III) and capped any renewal fee increase at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Our position is that renewals must be mutual, no longer than twelve months, and predictably priced; if a longer commitment is needed we could accept twelve-month automatic renewals with a 60-day opt-out and increases capped at 5%.

ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: The Agreement may be renewed for successive additional periods of twelve (12) months by mutual written agreement of the parties, and any increase in the fees payable for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding period and three percent (3%).
